ABOUT THIS COURSE

Course overview

Learn from the foremost leaders in AI innovation

Workshop ideas, gain insights, and foster connections during live sessions with a member of MIT Sloan Faculty.

Develop a practical AI adoption playbook

Move beyond the hype with a structured “Now, Near, and Next” strategy to identify transformative AI opportunities for your organization.

Duration: 6 weeks (excluding orientation)

Many organizations adopt AI, but few can translate it into demonstrable business outcomes. This MIT AI adoption course — brought to you by the co-creators of the acclaimed Artificial Intelligence: Implications for Business Strategy course, taken by 40,000+ business leaders — equips you with the practical frameworks to move beyond pilot projects and drive systemic AI adoption with measurable, long-term ROI in your organization. Over six weeks, you will systematically architect your adoption strategy, moving from identifying high-potential business challenges to aligning stakeholders and establishing the governance required to scale ethically and responsibly. Through a guided, practical approach, you’ll learn how to design systems that embrace human–machine co-productivity and enhance core human capabilities.

Each module includes an exclusive podcast episode hosted by an MIT Sloan Faculty member sharing their authoritative insights into decades of MIT research, theories, and practical AI strategies that are reshaping the world of work as we know it. Through playbook exercises and live sessions, you’ll build a custom playbook for navigating AI adoption challenges and opportunities — translating AI potential into lasting business impact.

By exploring the unique risk profile of systemic AI adoption, you’ll be able to diagnose why AI governance fails at an institutional level. Not only will you be able to use the knowledge you gain from the course to identify short- and long-term AI opportunities in your business context, but you’ll also be able to translate them from abstract possibilities into clear, strategic choices for your organization.

Is this MIT AI adoption program for you?

AI Adoption: Driving Business Value and Impact is ideal for mid-to-senior leaders and decision-makers who need to build, lead, or scale AI adoption across the organization.

Get started

What will set you apart

On completion of this course, you’ll walk away with:
A tailored playbook and proven frameworks that show you how to lead sustainable systemic AI adoption in your organization.
The ability to recalibrate your human–machine partnerships according to the 4R model — Roles, Relationships, Responsibilities, and Realities.
The skills to frame and solve high-value AI challenges and opportunities using Algorithmic Business Thinking.
Portfolio-based frameworks that align technology, operations, people, culture and change management to optimize AI.
An understanding of how to manage an AI-enabled organization responsibly, using governance strategies that translate AI ethics from abstract principles into management choices.

Course curriculum

As you progress through the weekly modules of this online short course, you will develop a practical, custom blueprint for successful systemic AI adoption in your organization.

About the certificate

Learn how to successfully orchestrate organizational AI adoption and earn an official certificate of completion from MIT.

Assessment is continuous and based on a series of practical assignments completed online. In order to be issued with your digital certificate, you’ll need to meet the requirements outlined in the course handbook. The handbook will be made available to you as soon as you begin the program.

Your digital certificate will be issued in your legal name and sent to you upon successful completion of the course, as per the stipulated requirements.

FAQ

Want to know more?

01

Why choose GetSmarter?

GetSmarter operates as edX's partner for premium online short course products from the world's leading universities and institutions. With edX, we leverage our people, technology, and resources to power your education and your potential.

We deliver market-led courses that equip working professionals with the expertise required to upskill, reskill or kickstart a completely new career. Through a data-driven approach, we analyze future skills requirements and ensure all courses address this need. We ensure that leading universities and institutions are your expert guides and our people, technology, and resources are your engine – together we power more than just education, we power your potential.

Read more about GetSmarter here and edX here.

Find out more about GetSmarter’s approach to digital learning, course design, and online delivery here.

02

Payment options

You can pay your course fees before the course starts, or you may opt for a split payment plan on courses that are nine weeks and shorter. For courses 10 weeks and longer, there is a three-part payment plan available. To find out more about payment options please visit our Payment and Financing page, or contact an enrollment specialist, to find out which option you qualify for.

03

Manage your time

GetSmarter's learning model is designed to help you, as a working professional, improve your skills without compromising on work and family responsibilities. The course work is broken up into weekly, manageable bite-sized modules, with incremental deadlines, designed to help you pace yourself over the duration of the course and allow you the legroom to work when it suits you best.

At the beginning of each module you'll be presented with the course content and assignments necessary for completion. You also have access to your enrollment specialist who will help you manage your time, and support you with any administrative or technical queries you might have.

04

Seek employer assistance

By improving your skills and industry knowledge, you'll have an influence on the success of your organization. Why wouldn't you ask your boss to help you fund your studies if it's going to have an impact on the way you do business?

Of our past students, 37 percent have received financial assistance from their employers. You can ask for help, too. Here is a guide to show you how to request financial assistance from your employer.

If you are a Learning & Development (L&D) manager, or involved in training and upskilling for an organization, you can request information regarding our corporate offering on our GetSmarter for business page.

05

How to change your start date

As part of our commitment to your professional development, GetSmarter offers you a two-week period to change your course start date or request your money back if you’re not fully satisfied.

To qualify for a deferral of your course start date, or to cancel your enrollment and receive a refund of your course fee, your request would need to reach our enrollment specialists before the release of Module 2. For more information, please read our Terms and Conditions.

06

Discover the Online Campus

The Online Campus will be your virtual classroom for the duration of your course. Through its easy-to-use interface you'll have access to a diverse variety of course content formats including: interactive videos, module notes, practice quizzes, presentations, assignment briefs, and additional web resources.

On the Online Campus, you'll also be able to ask questions and interact with your fellow students and teaching team through the discussion forums. If you are looking for your Online Campus login, please visit your Account page here.
